risk_note: Money path, RV2. W10 resolving as paid now cross-checks the serial number and amount a person gives against what the system already holds (08 BR-WDR-15 细则, D10-703; contract CT-24zu): another withdrawal's success bill line with that serial (out_biz_no set and not this one) refuses resolve_order_id_other_order; this withdrawal's latest success query answer or any of its success bill lines naming another serial refuses resolve_order_id_mismatch; any of its success bill lines with an amount other than net_fen refuses resolve_amount_mismatch. A refusal writes nothing of the withdrawal (the 2xxxx answer rolls the request back) and one withdrawal_resolve_refused audit record, written after the request's transaction has released its connection (money review r1 S1: the admin pool holds 3 connections). A line without out_biz_no (offline transfer) is not another withdrawal's. A paid_at more than 5 minutes from the success query's paid time only warns and notes paid_at_differs_from_query on the audit. Without evidence nothing changes. audit-log-view derives the refusal's target and permission. Frozen tests: B2-09s #8 and #30 were aligned before this task by the test-change PR #2549 (D10-756); B2-09u #10 was split out of its it.each table (D10-737) and carried forward as [AC-B2-09x#17] at the end of the same file (D10-754).

reviews.note: Codex via codex-run.sh. couli-runs/B2-09x/money-review-r1.json failed on one S1 (the refusal audit asked the 3-connection admin pool for a second connection while the request held one, so three concurrent refusals could starve it) and one S2 (with two success lines of different serials one matching line let it pass); both fixed in the implementation only. money-review-r2.json passed. No rule test pins the pool exhaustion: the test rounds were used up (3 of 3). Reviewed before the rebase.

The author restored the 2nd attempt's #17 text from the 3rd attempt's own log (it read the file before moving it) and compared it with the moved block: identical, 4176 characters. A fresh Claude reviewed (approvals 19), static, r1 pass: it confirmed one by one the 9 red_exempt entries ([AC-B2-09u#1]-#9, bodies byte-identical to base, the file judged as a whole only because unknown-harness.ts imports by a computed name) and the 2 red_exempt_rows ([AC-B2-09u#11], #12, kept rows of the split table), and #17 'only more, nothing less' against the original #10. Two S2 left open: every cross-check case uses the default status map (an implementation hard-coding 'SUCCESS' would pass; the implementation reads query_status_map), and the refusal audit privacy check bans a fixed key list. Mutation evidence: the frozen #8 and #30 of B2-09s went red on this implementation before #2549 aligned them, which is how the conflict was found.
